notes.title: Nothing due before Monday
notes.body: Martina Andreani sent the Financial Accounting plan: five sessions, Monday to Friday, and Session 1 needs nothing beforehand. Each reading and exercise is set after the session before it, so the prep falls in your evenings rather than this weekend. - Your group is expected to attempt the exercises together, so find them early in the week.
acted: Added the Financial Accounting week to your Business Foundations calendar entry: what each session covers and which exercise belongs to which day.
